translations.web: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
translations.bsb: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.
translations.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
translations.asv: And there were gathered unto him great multitudes, so that he entered into a boat, and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
